name: Banxsy
quote: Scribble on the forehead of the deity.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: What the hell... Working so early in the morning...

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: It's about time for you to take a break, don't you think?

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: I prefer time to myself in the evenings.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: It's midnight. The fun is about to start.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: People should stay true to their own ambitions. Same goes for Dolls. I'll never be confined by stereotypes.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Nobody can tell me what to do. I can go anywhere I want to.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: You look real stupid when you're asleep.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: What is it? Wanna go spray some graffiti on the dorm walls with me?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hmph...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: What do you want?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Ugh... You're disgusting.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Tsk...

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: I'm Banxsy, and I'm an artist. The streets are my canvas, and my home. I don't leave any tracks, so no one can catch me.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Time to leave my mark.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I'm ready for bolder and more exciting challenges!

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Wanna catch me? Hah, I'd like to see you try! Hehehe... See 'ya!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Whatever.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Where I go, the battlefield follows.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Don't you try to run!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: A bunch of weaklings, how boring.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Tsk, what a waste of time...

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: How could I lose to the likes of you...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: An oath? Hmm... Doesn't sound so bad. Plus, we already have each other's trust, don't we? Nothing to worry about, then.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: What's so fun about having everyone huddle together on New Year's Day...What a bunch of sheep, just blindly following the trend. Well, I'll take this chance to do some graffiti while people aren't looking. Care to join me?

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: I don't have any chocolate, but I do have some gum. It's the real deal too. Here you go. Take it as a token of our friendship.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Wishing upon a shooting star on Tanabata... Do you believe in that? I never have... Well, I suppose it wouldn't hurt to  give it a try? ... What if my wish really comes true?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: It's called "Lord Tepes and the Undead Legion". Hehe, what do you think? Oh... I forgot this is the reception room. Well, whatever.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: I dress a bit formally sometimes too. I don't like trying to blend in with others, but sometimes it's unavoidable. It's fun pretending to be a normie, since observing their reactions while in their midst is a good time.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: If you want to say something, just say it. Stop dawdling. You're the only one who's ever going to get a birthday present from me.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: What's up? Why are you staring at me like that? You're giving me the creeps. If you have nothing important to say, just leave me alone.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
I'm the one who gets to decide what I'll do, where I'll be, or when I'll do it. I know not to go too far, and I don't need anyone else to tell me.
... Unrelated topic, but you seem interested in street art, is that right? Want me to teach you?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Most people have it set in their head that Dolls are only supposed to follow orders.
I was just a puppet dancing on the stage for people's entertainment, with the companies behind me pulling the strings. They created a fake persona for me, and I lived a life full of lies. A fake idol, worshipped pretentiously by a bunch of fake fans. Then, one day, I stumbled upon some random jumbled street art. I was enthralled. Funny, isn't it? ... That's when I realized I was wasting my time.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
People should live for themselves and themselves only—that's my mantra.
I'm not going to force my ideas upon anyone, and I don't think I'm always 100% correct. That being said, fools who don't value themselves are bound to be used and manipulated, with nothing but a tool left inside.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Do you believe the things I say?
Maybe I don't like most people out there. That I won't deny. But I'm not going to deceive anyone, ever. That includes you. You seem like someone who can respect other people's beliefs and  put faith in the judgment and ideals of others...

career:
Cyber Media's claim to fame is their Artist series of Dolls. In addition to the standard empathy module and vast artistic resource center seen in other creative series, the Artist series Dolls also possess a unique computational algorithm.

This algorithm will pull the latest information in real-time and carry out intelligent integration. It will then take these findings and expand upon them, allowing for imaginative and innovative capabilities similar to a quasi-intelligent organism.

Banxsy was initially under the employ of Nun-sence Visual Art, a subsidiary of Cyber Media. However, her stellar performance resulted in her being promoted internally up to an "independent" creator affiliated with Cyber Media. Once she came to know of Neural Cloud, she and some other like-minded individuals took part in some special testing and eventually made the cut.
infoStories:
A genius for the new generation, an artist unlike any before her... In the months following her awakening, Banxsy was inundated with praise from influencers and fans alike. However, she found no joy in any of it, and was only left feeling empty inside.

Everything that she "created" here was merely a cog in the creative machine devised by the company. She was a puppet dancing for a crowd that was in the dark, garnering praise as those behind the stage pulled the strings.

Then, one day, after undergoing some special stimulation, she couldn't take it anymore. She felt the urge to free herself from this creative prison.

Banxsy began to consciously look for opportunities until one day she won an internal competition between company staff with her own artwork. This allowed her to apply to become an independent creator, whereupon she would have greater autonomy and fewer restrictions imposed upon her by other departments.

For Banxsy, this was a way to freedom from being a puppet. She could cut the strings and become her own master, a creator free to express herself as she wished. However, in the eyes of the mainstream media, who had previously lavished her with praise, this was far from ideal.

As many had expected, the artistic style of the newly-independent Banxsy underwent a drastic change. Her artistry was soon imbued with a rebellious streak, as she came to utilize street art as her main form of expression.

She attacked draconic dogma, and exposed its seedy underbelly. Now free of her shackles, nothing was free from Banxsy's critiquing canvas, and she did not shy away from expressing controversial viewpoints. As the influence of her artworks grew, the mainstream media's assessment of Banxsy took a nosedive. "Ostentatious", "reactionary", "traitorous", "stubborn"... A barrage of negative criticism was thrown Banxsy's way.

However, while pieces of art themselves can be battered and bruised, the spirit behind them is forever untouchable.

Of course, there was more to Banxsy's life than just street art. For her, graffiti was merely a form of artistic expression. In fact, she would more often spend time exercising with an ab wheel or darting through every street corner, every rooftop, every nook and cranny of the city along with other disaffected youth.

For a time, Banxsy felt that if she were an actual human, she would want to be amongst these young people.

Regardless of the time period, young people are always the most passionate. They have a clear understanding of themselves, and are the only ones who can break free from the restraints imposed upon them by the outside world. Only they can create a better tomorrow.

Banxsy is enamored with this sense of vitality. She feels it is one of the few things that is a uniquely human trait.

For the city's law enforcement, Banxsy's graffiti was a continual thorn in their side. Banxsy, however, paid them no mind and continued to walk the thin line between legality and criminality as she expressed her voice to society.

Banxsy does, however, on occasion side with law enforcement when things are taken too far. Whenever people commit crimes under the guise of being her followers, Banxsy will surreptitiously aid law enforcement in bringing the perpetrators to justice.

Banxsy has nothing but contempt for this kind of behavior. She fights the power in all its forms, and has no desire to take that power for herself.

Art must never be given a label, whether it be the individual or the collective.
—Caption found on a piece of graffiti entitled On the Artist and the Merchant

In her early days at the Oasis, Banxsy consciously reduced her creative output. For one, Magrasea was not in a state that allowed anyone to expend their energy on something that didn't serve an explicit purpose. Another reason was that when compared to the outside world, the relatively unsullied Oasis did not contain anything deserving overly trenchant criticism.

Although the artistic process is not beholden to the presence or absence of an audience, the fact that there was no need for subversive graffiti of any kind did negatively affect Banxsy's creativity. Most important of all was that the authority figure in this place, the Professor, was someone that she didn't mind.

Therefore, as time went on, Banxsy began to look for someone to enter Magrasea along with her. Spray painting, singing, DJing, skateboarding... In this world of their own creation, they could spend time together in utter bliss.

Occasionally, she would think to herself how wonderful it would be if she could live like this forever.

But, despite the comfort it provided her, this thought would never last long. After all, for someone involved in the arts, a smooth and steady life meant the death of inspiration and the wilting of passion. For one who creates, such a life is anathema.
oathDesc: Brightly-colored and one of a kind, a piece made just for you.

projections.name: Street Graffiti Artist
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Graffiti is the best way to scream your feelings out for everyone to see. There's nothing to worry about, you have the weapon of expression in your own hands."

projections.desc:

"Graffiti is the best way to scream your feelings out for everyone to see. There's nothing to worry about, you have the weapon of expression in your own hands."

projections.name: Color Thrower
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Colors and lines together make a poignant language."

skinList.name: Floating Colors
skinList.desc:
[Call of Study Series]
Banxsy often slips away during class to record her latest inspiration on one of the school walls. Capturing the fleeting inspiration is her top priority, and she doesn't ever expect anyone to understand her actions.

skinList.name: White Sands Party
skinList.desc:
From the "Seaside Concerto" series — an exquisite intersection of fashion and the human body's dynamics. Boldly show yourself off and enjoy yourself to your hearts' content amidst the azure waves.
This wild party on the ivory sands seems perfect for Banxsy: It has fire, waterguns and lots of noice, as well as her taking a little break in the corner.
"We don't get to go wild like this often; why not free your hands and feet and just go crazy?"

skinList.name: Lost R'lyeh
skinList.desc:
The ruler of old has awakened in the sunken city of R'lyeh, separated from His former domain by the vastness of the sea. The girl seized in the grip of her nightmares has become the sole medium through which this ancient god can comprehend the outside world.
When the stars are right, the master of this city shall emerge from the depths of the ocean with His minions.

skinList.name: Zenith's Edges
skinList.desc:
The howling of an engine and tires sweep across the arena like a tidal wave. Her figure is always by your side, rushing towards the finish line surrounded with countless flags.
Sparks sprinkle as she drifts, penning a beautiful arc accompanied by the smell of burning—Banxsy, always one to keep up with street culture, speeds along the track.
""Come keep up with me, Professor.""
